description: Mohist Agent reuses OpenCode execution capability and ACP is fully removed: AgentJob drives OpenCodeRuntime directly via an Agent-owned request, the launch pipeline stays unified, the issue-level AgentConfig surface converges to model/variant, and every ACP code path, dependency, and term is deleted.

tasks.title: Migrate AgentJob execution to the shared OpenCodeRuntime via an Agent-owned runner entry
tasks.spec: specs/agent-job-execution/spec.md#An AgentJob drives the shared OpenCodeRuntime directly via an Agent-owned execution request
tasks.description: Add a new Agent-owned execution entry in packages/runner/src/runtime/ (either a method on WorkExecutor or a dedicated AgentJobExecutor composed by the host) that branches on work.ownerKind === 'agent-job' BEFORE Action resolution, builds a RuntimeTurnRequest from the dispatch, calls OpenCodeRuntime.runTurn directly, reports the physical session binding back via the existing /api/runner/{runnerId}/agent-sessions/{projectId}/{sessionId}/attach endpoint, and returns an ActionResult whose output JSON keeps the legacy {kind, status, runtimeSessionId, model, variant, text, error} shape so AgentJobGrain.ReportResultAsync's success/failure parsing and FailureCategoryFrom keep working unchanged. Remove the ownerKind === 'agent-job' ? null : openCodeRuntime gate in baseContext (executor.ts:387) so the runtime handle reaches AgentJob work uniformly; remove the transitional readiness-gate caveat comment at host.ts:513. Flip the server atomically: AgentLauncher.cs:97 stops passing Uses: 'mohist/acp-agent'; AgentJobGrain.BuildDispatch stops emitting Uses, with.agent, with.model, and the {agent-launch: ...} envelope, and instead writes a flat {prompt, instructions?, model?, variant?} payload in With; ComposePromptWithEntry and ApplyAgentRuntimeConfig are deleted; AgentJobInput.Uses is removed. Keep workspace prep skip and workspaceFromVariables for AgentJob unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: A manual `mo agent session launch` (fake-runtime runner test) produces a Completed AgentJob whose execution drove OpenCodeRuntime.runTurn directly, verified by fake-runtime call capture
An event-subscription launch (fake-runtime runner test) drives the same runTurn path through the same Agent-owned entry
Editing the Agent definition's instructions/model/variant while an AgentJob is Running does not change the running turn's inputs (fake-runtime assertion against the launch-time snapshot)
Archiving the Agent definition while an AgentJob is Pending or Running does not cancel or fail the job

AgentJobGrain.ReportResultAsync transitions Running → Completed on a success runtime turn and Running → Failed on a failure turn; the AgentSession's transcript/usage/lineage events do not transition the job

RecordRuntimeSessionBindingAsync accepts the first binding report for a job, returns idempotent success on a repeat of the same runtimeSessionId, and rejects a report whose runner/work/session id differs from the persisted values

A dispatch whose target.runtimeSessionId is null creates a new physical OpenCode Session in workDir; a dispatch whose target.runtimeSessionId is non-null restores the existing physical Session without creating a new one
No new AgentJob WorkDispatch carries Uses: 'mohist/acp-agent', a with.agent field, or a {agent-launch: ...} prompt envelope
baseContext sets openCodeRuntime to the runtime handle (not null) for ownerKind === 'agent-job' dispatches

default `npm test` for runner and server passes with the fake-runtime seam (extending the #409 setOpenCodeRuntimeFactoryForTest) and a fake ServerConnection that captures attach calls; no real OpenCode process, network, fs, or wall-clock in default tests
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/ (new Agent-owned entry), packages/runner/src/runtime/executor.ts (gate removal), packages/runner/src/runtime/host.ts (caveat removal), packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Agent/Services/AgentLauncher.cs, packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Agent/Grains/AgentJobGrain.cs, packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Agent/Grains/IAgentJobGrain.cs (AgentJobInput.Uses removed), and fake-driven runner+server tests
tasks.notes: This is the atomic switchover described in design D1+D2. The mohist/acp-agent Action registration and the ACP runtime stay in place after this task (dead but compiling) so the change stays self-contained; T-004 deletes them. If OpenCodeRuntime needs Follow-up/Cancel exposed as public methods, that lands in T-003 — T-001 only needs runTurn + createSession, which #409 already exposes.

tasks.title: Converge the issue-level AgentConfig surface to model and variant across API, CLI, and Web
tasks.spec: specs/issue-agent-config/spec.md#Issue-level AgentConfig inputs accept only model and variant metadata
tasks.description: Drop the dead CreateIssueRequest.AgentConfig and UpdateIssueRequest.AgentConfig DTO fields (parsed but never consumed by IssueRoutes.Crud.cs). Extend IssueModelMetadata.Validate (or add a sibling validator invoked from the issue and agent-definition routes) to reject any ACP/liveness key (type, livenessQuietThresholdMs, probeTimeoutMs, sessionStartTimeoutMs, compaction) on issue create/update and on AgentCreateRequest.AgentConfig/AgentUpdateRequest.AgentConfig. Stop the web project-layer writers (entities/settings/api/client.ts updateOpencodeModel line ~64 and setStageModel line ~200) from stamping type: 'opencode'; write {model, variant} only. Update writeAgentModelAndVariant (entities/agent/api/client.ts:106-124) to stop preserving legacy keys via spread; return {model, variant} only. Whitelist-filter at every read-in point that feeds vars.agent (IssueVariableBuilder.Build with agentConfig, MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase.MergeAgentConfig, IssueWorkflowProfileStorageIntegrity.FoldAgentDataIntoBundle, ConfigService.GetAgentConfigAsync) so legacy keys never enter vars.agent from any active write path. Filter IssueQuerier.ReadAgentConfig (and the per-stage read) to surface only model/variant on response. Drop the agentType derivation in pages/agent-detail/ui/AgentDetailPage.tsx:159-166; the Agent Config card shows model/variant only.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/projects/{p}/issues with agentConfig containing type, livenessQuietThresholdMs, probeTimeoutMs, sessionStartTimeoutMs, or compaction returns 400 with an actionable validation error
PATCH /api/projects/{p}/issues/{n} with the same forbidden keys returns 400
POST /api/projects/{p}/agents and PATCH with agentConfig containing any forbidden key return 400
GET /api/projects/{p}/issues/{n} returns agentConfig containing at most {model, variant} even when the persisted vars.agent carries legacy keys
GET /api/projects/{p}/agents/{a} returns agentConfig containing at most {model, variant}
The project settings web form (AiSettingsSection) saves without stamping type: 'opencode' (verified by inspecting the patched bundle)
The agent profile editor (AgentProfileEditor) saves an agent whose persisted agentConfig contains only {model, variant}; legacy keys are not preserved via spread
AgentDetailPage no longer renders an agent-type field
Already-persisted legacy keys remain in storage (no rewrite); a unit test confirms a persisted vars.agent with type/liveness keys is not mutated by the storage-integrity defensive-copy path
The mohist/opencode runtime's unknownKeys diagnostic path still records legacy keys as diagnostics when they reach an execution request (covered by the #409 fake-runtime test, asserted unchanged)
default `npm test` (server), `npm run typecheck -w packages/web`, and `npm run test:run -w packages/web` pass
tasks.output: packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Api/IssueRoutes.Dtos.cs (DTO field drop), packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/IssueModelMetadata.cs (validate forbidden keys), packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Api/AgentDefinitionRoutes.cs (agent-definition reject path), packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/IssueQuerier.cs (read-back filter), packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/IssueVariableBuilder.cs + WorkflowProfiles/MohistIssueWorkflowProfileBase.cs + WorkflowProfiles/IssueWorkflowProfileStorageIntegrity.cs + Infrastructure/Config/ConfigService.cs (write-side whitelist), packages/web/src/entities/settings/api/client.ts + entities/agent/api/client.ts + widgets/agent-profile-editor/ui/AgentProfileEditor.tsx + pages/agent-detail/ui/AgentDetailPage.tsx (no type stamping/spreading/rendering), and server+web spec/unit tests
tasks.notes: Independent of T-001 — touches issue/agent DTOs and web forms, not the AgentJob execution path. Lands in parallel. Design D5.

tasks.title: Rework Follow-up, Cancel, and failure-outbox handlers to target the OpenCode runtime
tasks.spec: specs/acp-removal/spec.md#The ActionContext and runner handlers have no ACP fields or coupling
tasks.description: Promote Follow-up (wraps client.session.promptAsync) and Cancel (wraps client.session.abort) to public methods on OpenCodeRuntime with the same Mohist-owned RuntimeResult<T> shape used by runTurn, if they are not already public after #409. Redefine FollowupTarget in packages/runner/src/server/session-target.ts to drop connection: ClientSideConnection; the new shape is a Mohist-owned value object {runtimeSessionId, workDir, projectId}. Rework server/followup-handler.ts, server/cancel-handler.ts, and server/followup-failure-outbox.ts to resolve the target through the persisted binding (the same source the Workflow path already uses) and call OpenCodeRuntime.followup / OpenCodeRuntime.cancel instead of any ACP RPC. Keep the FollowupTargetResolver injection pattern so tests inject a fake resolver plus a fake runtime. Delete resolveFollowupTarget, restoreSessionTarget, resumeSessionTarget, installRestoredSessionHandlers, and the sessionRestorations dedup map from runtime/host.ts; restart/reconnect reconciliation stays owned by OpenCodeRuntime per #409 D7 (persisted binding + session.status/get/messages snapshot). Update followup-failure-outbox branching to use kind only (workflow vs generic); drop the SessionTarget kind's reliance on a live connection.
acceptanceCriteria: A Follow-up against a session with a current OpenCode binding calls OpenCodeRuntime.followup and returns immediately; no ClientSideConnection is consulted (fake-runtime assertion)
A Cancel against an active OpenCode turn calls OpenCodeRuntime.cancel and returns cancelled
A Follow-up or Cancel against a session whose binding is not 'opencode' fails with the existing missing taxonomy and the Reset hint
A Follow-up or Cancel when OpenCodeRuntime.ready() is false returns the existing unavailable taxonomy
followup-failure-outbox publishes failure events by target.kind (workflow vs generic) without referencing ClientSideConnection
runtime/host.ts no longer holds a sessionRestorations map, no longer restores ACP sessions on reconnect, and no longer calls resumeSession
The FollowupTarget type does not reference ClientSideConnection or @agentclientprotocol/sdk
default `npm test` for runner passes with a fake runtime and a fake SignalR connection; no real process/network/fs/clock
tasks.output: packages/runner/src/runtime/opencode/runtime.ts (public followup/cancel methods if not already), packages/runner/src/server/session-target.ts (FollowupTarget redefinition), packages/runner/src/server/followup-handler.ts, packages/runner/src/server/cancel-handler.ts, packages/runner/src/server/followup-failure-outbox.ts, packages/runner/src/runtime/host.ts (delete ACP restore/resume helpers), and runner tests
tasks.notes: Depends on T-001 because the readiness-gate caveat removal and the OpenCodeRuntime handle wiring done there are prerequisites for the runtime-targeted handlers. Design D3.

tasks.title: Delete the ACP code, dependency, and recognition; surface an actionable error for the removed Action
tasks.spec: specs/acp-removal/spec.md#The runner has no ACP SDK dependency
tasks.description: Delete packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts, the entire packages/runner/src/actions/acp/ tree, packages/runner/src/runtime/acp-connection.ts, runtime/acp-command.ts, runtime/acp-session-command.ts(.test), and the corresponding test files (tests/acp/**, tests/support/fake-acp.ts, tests/support/liveness-probe-test-utils.ts, tests/acp-command.test.ts, tests/acp-connection.spec.ts). Remove mohist/acp-agent from actions/registry.ts. Relocate buildPromptLoaderContext and sessionNameFromContext out of the deleted actions/acp/ subtree so actions/opencode.ts keeps building (e.g. into actions/opencode-helpers.ts or a shared runtime/helpers module). Drop ActionContext.acpSessionManager/acpConnection from core/types.ts; drop WorkExecutor.sessionManager/acpConnection fields and the updateAcpConnection mutator; drop the parameters from baseContext. Delete runtime/host.ts's initializeSharedConnection ACP init, sharedAcpConnection/sessionManager fields, shutdownSharedConnection, and the per-work ephemeral fallback at :834-865. Replace runtime/worktree-enforcement.ts's cleanupAgentAction = acpAgentAction with an OpenCode-backed cleanup entry (preserving the dirty-worktree cleanup contract: no push, only git add/commit/checkout/restore/clean). Drop the LEGACY_AGENT_BACKED_USES literal from runtime/worktree-cleanup.ts so isAgentBackedTask recognizes mohist/opencode only. Update system/timeout-signal.ts comment to drop the mohist/acp-agent reference. Remove @agentclientprotocol/sdk from packages/runner/package.json. Remove MOHIST_AGENT_ARGS reads (the env surface disappears entirely; MOHIST_AGENT_COMMAND stays as the verbose-inspector source of truth). Collapse Runner/Services/WorkflowItemTranslator.IsInlineAgentUses and Workflow/Services/WorkflowYamlSerializer.IsInlineAgentUses to mohist/opencode-only; drop the acp-agent substring branch from Workflow/Domain/Run/TaskRun.DeriveClassification; update the Api/IssueRoutes.Helpers.cs:165 recovery fixture to stop naming mohist/acp-agent; clean ACP wording from Sessions/Services/AgentSessionQuerier.cs:413,852 doc-comments. Replace the web widgets/issue-workflow/ui/milestones.ts:26-33 isAcpAgentTask classifier with an OpenCode-based or runtime-neutral classifier. Upgrade the runner's generic 'No action found for ${work.uses}' error at runtime/executor.ts:135 to an actionable, named error when work.uses === 'mohist/acp-agent' (and a small RemovedActions set in general) that points to rerunning the affected stage with a mohist/opencode profile. Sweep test fixtures still naming 'mohist/acp-agent' or acpSessionId (rename for clarity, drop where the underlying behavior is gone).
acceptanceCriteria: packages/runner/package.json no longer declares @agentclientprotocol/sdk; `npm ls @agentclientprotocol/sdk` from packages/runner reports unmet / not found
packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts and the packages/runner/src/actions/acp/ directory do not exist
packages/runner/src/runtime/acp-connection.ts, runtime/acp-command.ts, and runtime/acp-session-command.ts do not exist; their test files are gone
actions/registry.ts registers mohist/opencode only (no mohist/acp-agent)
actions/opencode.ts does not import any helper from actions/acp/ (the relocated helpers live elsewhere)
ActionContext type (core/types.ts) has no acpSessionManager or acpConnection field
WorkExecutor has no sessionManager/acpConnection fields; baseContext threads no ACP state and passes openCodeRuntime uniformly across owner kinds
runtime/host.ts has no SharedAcpConnection, no AcpSessionManager, no initializeSharedConnection ACP init, no shutdownSharedConnection, and no per-work ephemeral fallback
The runner host does not spawn opencode acp on startup; the single isOpenCodeReadyForClaim() gate applies uniformly to Workflow and AgentJob work
No runner source file reads MOHIST_AGENT_ARGS

Runner/Services/WorkflowItemTranslator.IsInlineAgentUses and Workflow/Services/WorkflowYamlSerializer.IsInlineAgentUses treat mohist/opencode as the only inline agent; they do not recognize mohist/acp-agent
Workflow/Domain/Run/TaskRun.DeriveClassification no longer consults the substring 'acp-agent'
Api/IssueRoutes.Helpers.cs recovery fixture no longer names mohist/acp-agent
AgentSessionQuerier.cs doc-comments at :413 and :852 carry no ACP wording
Web production source tree has no isAcpAgentTask identifier and no acpSessionId references

A pre-cutover WorkflowRun dispatching a task whose persisted uses is mohist/acp-agent fails with a named, actionable error pointing to stage rerun with a mohist/opencode profile (not the generic 'No action found')
A custom profile naming uses: mohist/acp-agent fails at profile load with an actionable error
runtime/worktree-enforcement.ts cleanup action no longer references acpAgentAction; dirty-worktree cleanup still runs and preserves the git-add/commit/checkout/restore/clean-only contract
`npm run build`, `npm test` (root, server, runner), `npm run typecheck -w packages/runner`, `npm run typecheck -w packages/web`, and `npm run test:run -w packages/web` all pass
